bio.text: Caitlyn Gegen, a Suwanee resident when she announced her run, won the May 19, 2026 Democratic primary for Georgia's 9th Congressional District and is on the November 3 ballot against Rep. Andrew Clyde.

She graduated from the University of Georgia in 2021 with a bachelor's degree in international relations and a master's degree in public administration, and later earned a degree from the London School of Economics in 2022.
She began working in politics in 2018 on a congressional campaign, and said her parents were both teachers in Gwinnett County Public Schools.

sources.title: Suwanee resident Caitlyn Gegen announces run for 9th Congressional District
